Card Q&A.q: I use this card's effect on one of my opponent's Digimon, which they then digivolve. Can it now attack and block?

Card Q&A.a: No, this card's security effect only affects Digimon. Your opponent's Tamers unsuspend as normal.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's security effect also prevent my opponent's suspended Tamers from unsuspending during their unsuspend phase?

Effect: [Main] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't attack or block.
Security Effect: [Security] Your opponent's Digimon don't unsuspend during their next unsuspend phase.
